scanNote:
12-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (84-bet) - JOYLAShUV, OB-HAVO, OTKRITKALAR.

Yuqorida chapda KO'K-YaShIL yorliqda oq '12' va 'Holidays with a Difference'.

CHAP USTUN:
• OCh KO'K QUTI 'Describing Location': 'We use these phrases to describe the location of a place: is situated/located, etc in the east/west/south-east, etc of ...; on the north/south/south-west, etc coast of ...; in the heart/centre of ...'
8) 'Look at the cities on the map and correct the statements, then talk about the location of each city.' ITALIYa XARITASI (sariq), qizil nuqtalar: Milan (shimoli-g'arb), Venice (shimoli-sharq), Florence (markaz-shimol), Rome (markaz-g'arbiy qirg'oq), Naples (janubi-g'arbiy qirg'oq). Kompas N/S/E/W.
   1 Milan is situated in the south-east of Italy. Ko'k qiya: 'Milan isn't situated in the south-east of Italy. It's in the north of Italy.' 2 Florence is situated in the south of Italy. 3 Venice is located on the west coast of Italy. 4 Rome is situated in the north of Italy. 5 Naples is on the east coast of Italy.
9) a) 'Match the symbols to the weather adjectives.' Qiya: 'cloudy, windy, sunny, stormy, snowy, rainy'. BELGILAR: 1 quyosh; 2 bulut va yomg'ir tomchilari; 3 puflayotgan bulut (shamol); 4 bulut va chaqmoq; 5 bulutlar; 6 qorbobo.

O'NG USTUN:
   b) Kasseta belgisi: 'Read the weather report, then listen and correct the two mistakes. Which map does the weather report match?' Matn: 'There will be mixed weather conditions all over the country today. Starting in the north, there will be quite a lot of rain, while the east coast can expect a cloudy day. The south of the country will be sunny, but the west can expect thunderstorms.'
   IKKI XARITA (ANGLIYa, yashil): A - shimolda yomg'ir, g'arbda shamol, janubda qorbobo (qor), sharqda quyosh. B - shimolda chaqmoqli bulut (momaqaldiroq), g'arbda yomg'ir, sharqda bulutlar, janubda quyosh.
   c) 'Look at the other map of England and write a weather report describing the weather conditions shown.'
10) 'Read the two postcards, then match the words in bold to their opposites in the list:' qiya 'terrible, stressful, boring, freezing cold, disgusting, dreadful, wet, unsuitable, ordinary, plain'.
   OTKRITKA 1 (plyaj surati): 'Dear Jan, We're having a 1) RELAXING holiday here in Mexico. Our room at the hotel is 2) IDEAL for Jeff, the kids and me, and it's very close to the beach. The weather is 3) BOILING HOT and the food is very 4) SPICY - we love it! We've visited some 5) INTERESTING places and I hope to see lots more. You must visit this country soon! Love, Karen'
   OTKRITKA 2 (oila mehmonxona xonasida): 'Dear Paul, We're having a 6) FANTASTIC time here in the Alton Towers Hotel. We're staying in a 7) WONDERFUL room - the Explorer Room. The restaurant serves 8) DELICIOUS food. The weather has been warm and 9) DRY. There are some 10) EXTRAORDINARY attractions at the theme park. It's definitely worth a visit! Best wishes, George'
• To'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Use the pictures in the Photo File section to help you write two postcards. Write WHERE YOU ARE and WHERE YOU ARE STAYING, what the WEATHER/FOOD is like and your RECOMMENDATION. Use the postcards in Ex. 10 as models.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '84'.

exercises.instructionEn: We use these phrases to describe the location of a place.
exercises.instructionUz: Joyning joylashuvini tasvirlash uchun ushbu iboralarni ishlatamiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
JOYLAShUV IBORALARI:

  is situated/located IN the
    east/west/south-east OF ...
    = ...ning sharqida/g'arbida/
    janubi-sharqida joylashgan
  ON the north/south/south-west
    coast OF ...
    = ...ning shimoliy/janubiy/
    janubi-g'arbiy qirg'og'ida
  IN the heart/centre OF ...
    = ...ning markazida


⚠ 'IN' yoki 'ON'?

  IN the north OF = shimolida
    (ichkarida)
  ON the north COAST OF = shimoliy
    QIRG'OG'IDA
  ⚠ 'coast' bilan har doim 'on'!


⚠ 'SITUATED' = 'LOCATED':

  = joylashgan.
  ⚠ 'is situated' - passiv shakl.


⚠ YO'NALIShLAR:

  north = shimol; south = janub;
  east = sharq; west = g'arb;
  north-east = shimoli-sharq;
  south-west = janubi-g'arb.

points.en: is situated/located in the east/west/south-east of ...

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the cities on the map and correct the statements, then talk about the location of each city.
exercises.instructionUz: Xaritadagi shaharlarga qarang va gaplarni to'g'rilang, keyin har shahar joylashuvi haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Milan isn't situated in the
   south-east of Italy. It's in the
   north of Italy.'


XARITA (ITALIYa):
  Milan - shimol (shimoli-g'arb)
  Venice - shimoli-sharq
  Florence - markaz (shimoliy qism)
  Rome - g'arbiy qirg'oq, markaz
  Naples - janubi-g'arbiy qirg'oq


TO'G'RILANGAN GAPLAR:

  1 Milan isn't in the south-east.
    It's in the north of Italy.
  2 Florence isn't in the south.
    It's in the centre of Italy.
  3 Venice isn't on the west coast.
    It's on the north-east coast of
    Italy.
  4 Rome isn't in the north. It's in
    the centre of Italy, on the
    west coast.
  5 Naples isn't on the east coast.
    It's on the south-west coast of
    Italy.


⚠ ShAHAR NOMLARI:

  Milan = Milan; Venice = Venetsiya;
  Florence = Florensiya; Rome = Rim;
  Naples = Neapol.

items.sentence: 1 Milan is situated in the south-east of Italy.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Milan isn't situated in the south-east of Italy. It's in the NORTH of Italy. (namuna)

items.sentence: 2 Florence is situated in the south of Italy.

items.sentence: 3 Venice is located on the west coast of Italy.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Venice isn't on the west coast. It's on the NORTH-EAST coast of Italy.

items.sentence: 4 Rome is situated in the north of Italy.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Rome isn't in the north. It's in the CENTRE of Italy, on the west coast.

items.sentence: 5 Naples is on the east coast of Italy.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Naples isn't on the east coast. It's on the SOUTH-WEST coast of Italy.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the symbols to the weather adjectives. cloudy, windy, sunny, stormy, snowy, rainy
exercises.instructionUz: Belgilarni ob-havo sifatlariga moslang. cloudy, windy, sunny, stormy, snowy, rainy
exercises.explanationUz:
BELGILAR:
  1 quyosh → sunny
  2 yomg'ir tomchilari → rainy
  3 puflayotgan bulut → windy
  4 chaqmoq → stormy
  5 bulutlar → cloudy
  6 qorbobo → snowy


⚠ OT + Y = SIFAT:

  sun → sunNy (n ikkilanadi)
  rain → rainy
  wind → windy
  storm → stormy
  snow → snowy
  cloud → cloudy


⚠ 'IT'S SUNNY' = 'THE SUN IS
SHINING'.
⚠ 'IT'S RAINY' = 'IT'S RAINING'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the weather report, then listen and correct the two mistakes. Which map does the weather report match? "There will be mixed weather conditions all over the country today. Starting in the north, there will be quite a lot of rain, while the east coast can expect a cloudy day. The south of the country will be sunny, but the west can expect thunderstorms."
exercises.instructionUz: Ob-havo ma'lumotini o'qing, keyin tinglang va ikkita xatoni to'g'rilang. Ob-havo ma'lumoti qaysi xaritaga mos keladi? "Bugun butun mamlakat bo'ylab aralash ob-havo sharoitlari bo'ladi. Shimoldan boshlasak, ancha ko'p yomg'ir bo'ladi, sharqiy qirg'oq esa bulutli kunni kutishi mumkin. Mamlakat janubi quyoshli bo'ladi, lekin g'arb momaqaldiroq kutishi mumkin."
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - lekin xaritadan
topish mumkin.


XARITALAR:
  A: shimol - yomg'ir; g'arb -
     shamol; janub - qor; sharq -
     quyosh
  B: shimol - momaqaldiroq; g'arb -
     yomg'ir; sharq - bulutli;
     janub - quyosh

MATN: shimol - yomg'ir; sharq -
bulutli; janub - quyosh; g'arb -
momaqaldiroq.

  → Sharq va janub B ga mos.
  → IKKI XATO: shimol va g'arb
    almashgan!

TO'G'RILANGAN:
  'Starting in the north, there
   will be THUNDERSTORMS, while the
   east coast can expect a cloudy
   day. The south of the country
   will be sunny, but the west can
   expect QUITE A LOT OF RAIN.'

  → XARITA B.


⚠ 'A WEATHER REPORT':

  = ob-havo ma'lumoti.


⚠ 'MIXED':

  = aralash.


⚠ 'CONDITIONS':

  = sharoitlar.


⚠ 'TO EXPECT':

  = kutmoq.


⚠ 'A THUNDERSTORM':

  = momaqaldiroq (chaqmoqli bo'ron).
  ⚠ 'thunder' = momaqaldiroq ovozi;
  'lightning' = chaqmoq.


⚠ 'QUITE A LOT OF':

  = ancha ko'p.

points.en: Mistake 1: 'in the north, there will be quite a lot of rain' → in the north, there will be thunderstorms.
Mistake 2: 'the west can expect thunderstorms' → the west can expect quite a lot of rain.
points.uz: 2-xato: g'arbda momaqaldiroq → g'arbda ancha ko'p yomg'ir.

points.en: The weather report matches map B.
points.uz: Ob-havo ma'lumoti B xaritaga mos keladi.
points.noteUz: ⚠ Sharq bulutli, janub quyoshli - faqat B da.

exercises.explanationUz:
OTKRITKA 1 - KAREN (Meksika):

Aziz Jan,
Biz bu yerda, Meksikada, dam
oluvchi ta'til o'tkazyapmiz.
Mehmonxonadagi xonamiz Jeff, bolalar
va men uchun ideal, va u plyajga
juda yaqin. Ob-havo qaynoq issiq va
ovqat juda achchiq - bizga yoqadi!
Biz bir nechta qiziqarli joylarga
bordik va yana ko'p ko'rishga
umid qilaman. Siz bu mamlakatga
tez orada borishingiz kerak!
Muhabbat bilan, Karen


OTKRITKA 2 - GEORGE (Alton Towers):

Aziz Paul,
Biz bu yerda, Alton Towers
mehmonxonasida ajoyib vaqt
o'tkazyapmiz. Biz go'zal xonada -
Sayyoh xonasida turibmiz. Restoran
mazali ovqat beradi. Ob-havo issiq
va quruq bo'ldi. Mavzuli bog'da
ba'zi g'ayrioddiy attraksionlar bor.
Bu albatta tashrifga arziydi!
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, George


OTKRITKA TUZILIShI:
  1 Dear + ism,
  2 We're having a ... time/holiday
    here in ...
  3 Qayerda turibmiz (xona/
    mehmonxona)
  4 Ob-havo / ovqat
  5 Tavsiya (You must visit ... /
    It's worth a visit!)
  6 Love, / Best wishes, + ism


⚠ 'BOILING HOT':

  = qaynoq issiq (juda issiq).


⚠ 'SPICY':

  = achchiq (ziravorli).


⚠ 'TO SERVE':

  = (ovqat) bermoq, xizmat
  ko'rsatmoq.


⚠ 'AN ATTRACTION':

  = attraksion, diqqatga sazovor
  joy.


⚠ 'DEFINITELY':

  = albatta, aniq.


⚠ 'WORTH A VISIT':

  = tashrifga arziydi.
  ⚠ 'worth' = arziydi.

points.en: Dear Jan, We're having a relaxing holiday here in Mexico. Our room at the hotel is ideal for Jeff, the kids and me, and it's very close to the beach.
points.uz: Aziz Jan, Biz bu yerda, Meksikada, dam oluvchi ta'til o'tkazyapmiz. Mehmonxonadagi xonamiz Jeff, bolalar va men uchun ideal, va u plyajga juda yaqin.

points.en: The weather is boiling hot and the food is very spicy - we love it! We've visited some interesting places and I hope to see lots more. You must visit this country soon! Love, Karen
points.uz: Ob-havo qaynoq issiq va ovqat juda achchiq - bizga yoqadi! Biz bir nechta qiziqarli joylarga bordik va yana ko'p ko'rishga umid qilaman. Siz bu mamlakatga tez orada borishingiz kerak! Muhabbat bilan, Karen

points.en: Dear Paul, We're having a fantastic time here in the Alton Towers Hotel. We're staying in a wonderful room - the Explorer Room. The restaurant serves delicious food.
points.uz: Aziz Paul, Biz bu yerda, Alton Towers mehmonxonasida ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapmiz. Biz go'zal xonada - Sayyoh xonasida turibmiz. Restoran mazali ovqat beradi.

points.en: The weather has been warm and dry. There are some extraordinary attractions at the theme park. It's definitely worth a visit! Best wishes, George
points.uz: Ob-havo issiq va quruq bo'ldi. Mavzuli bog'da ba'zi g'ayrioddiy attraksionlar bor. Bu albatta tashrifga arziydi! Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, George

exercises.instructionEn: Match the words in bold to their opposites in the list: terrible, stressful, boring, freezing cold, disgusting, dreadful, wet, unsuitable, ordinary, plain
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin so'zlarni ro'yxatdagi antonimlariga moslang: terrible, stressful, boring, freezing cold, disgusting, dreadful, wet, unsuitable, ordinary, plain
exercises.explanationUz:
ANTONIMLAR:

  1 relaxing ↔ stressful
  2 ideal ↔ unsuitable
  3 boiling hot ↔ freezing cold
  4 spicy ↔ plain
  5 interesting ↔ boring
  6 fantastic ↔ terrible
  7 wonderful ↔ dreadful
  8 delicious ↔ disgusting
  9 dry ↔ wet
  10 extraordinary ↔ ordinary

  ⚠ 'terrible' va 'dreadful' -
  ikkalasi ham 'dahshatli'; fantastic/
  wonderful bilan almashtirsa
  bo'ladi.


⚠ 'STRESSFUL':

  = stressli, asabiy.


⚠ 'UNSUITABLE':

  = nomunosib, mos emas.
  ⚠ 'suitable' = mos.


⚠ 'FREEZING COLD':

  = muzday sovuq.
  ⚠ 'to freeze' = muzlamoq.


⚠ 'PLAIN':

  (ovqat) = oddiy, ziravorsiz.


⚠ 'DISGUSTING':

  = jirkanch (ovqat - juda yomon).


⚠ 'DREADFUL':

  = dahshatli.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the pictures in the Photo File section to help you write two postcards. Write where you are and where you are staying, what the weather/food is like and your recommendation. Use the postcards in Ex. 10 as models.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki otkritka yozishga yordam berish uchun Photo File bo'limidagi suratlardan foydalaning. Qayerdaligingiz va qayerda turganingiz, ob-havo/ovqat qanday ekani va tavsiyangizni yozing. 10-mashqdagi otkritkalardan namuna sifatida foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
OTKRITKA REJASI:

  1 Dear ...,
  2 We're having a ... time here
    in ... (QAYERDA)
  3 We're staying in/at ...
    (QAYERDA TURIBMIZ)
  4 The weather is ... / The food
    is ... (OB-HAVO/OVQAT)
  5 You must visit ... / It's worth
    a visit! (TAVSIYa)
  6 Love, / Best wishes, + ism

  ⚠ Photo File - kitob oxirida
  (suratlar bo'limi).


⚠ 'WHAT IS THE WEATHER LIKE?':

  = ob-havo qanday?
  ⚠ 'like' bu yerda 'yoqmoq' EMAS!
